Source: every knowledge fact in parts C and C2 of this section cites exactly one physical page, within physical pages nineteen to twenty-one, of the private snapshot of the Alabama Driver Manual edition dated on its front cover, the issuer's own publication, read from extracted page text.
Confidence: facts restated from a single explicit page sentence are high confidence; nothing in this section was taken from memory or from a non-issuer source.
Precision rule: point values, point-count thresholds, look-back periods and suspension lengths are kept exactly as printed, with the wording paraphrased so no learner line copies the manual.
Accuracy flags: physical pages twenty and twenty-one extracted with the suspension list repeated as a second overlapping text layer, an empty bullet after the following-too-closely item, a schedule lead-in reduced to the single word schedule, and a fragment saying something counts for a period of two years from conviction but remains on the record with its subject missing; facts were taken only from complete lines, and the two-year retention fragment was not turned into a fact (verify — sec03-D-FLAG).
Stability: the manual is one dated edition; any rule a later law or edition changes must be re-read from the current manual before reuse.
External review: no clinical or legal review is required; the content restates published licensing and traffic rules for exam preparation only.
